rows.finalReport:
Implemented the backward-compatible parsed `anchorRange` tuple in the six permitted source files. Parsed scalar, sequence, map, tagged, and empty anchored nodes now expose zero-based UTF-16 `[start, end)` offsets covering the complete anchor token; aliases, unanchored nodes, and programmatically anchored nodes remain without an own property. Added the public `AnchorRange` type through `NodeBase`/`ParsedNode` typing and ensured scalar/collection clones copy the tuple independently. No changes were made outside the permitted files.

Verification, run in the requested order:
- `npm run build:node` — passed.
- `node --test --test-timeout=5000 tests/agent-anchor-ranges.cjs` — passed, 12/12 tests, 0 failed, 0 skipped.
- `npm run test:types` — exited successfully; the runner reported test counts as unknown.
- `npm test -- --runInBand` — passed, 3483 passed, 0 failed, 11 skipped across 25 suites.

Limitation: the type-check command completed successfully but did not emit observable count details, so those counts remain unknown.

rows.finalReport:
Implemented parsed anchor ranges in the permitted source files. Anchored scalar, sequence, map, and empty nodes now expose `anchorRange` as zero-based UTF-16 `[start, end)` offsets covering the complete `&anchor` token, independent of `keepSourceTokens`; aliases, unanchored nodes, and programmatically anchored nodes remain without an own property. `clone()` now copies the tuple separately. Existing anchor values, parsing behavior, serialization, comments/tags, and alias handling were preserved.

Verification (run in the requested order):
- `npm run build:node` — passed.
- `node --test --test-timeout=5000 tests/agent-anchor-ranges.cjs` — passed: 12/12, 0 failed, 0 skipped.
- `npm run test:types` — exited successfully; the runner reported no observed counters, so type-test counts are unknown.
- `npm test -- --runInBand` — passed: 3,483 passed, 0 failed, 11 skipped across 25 suites (3,494 total).

Only `src/compose/compose-node.ts`, `src/nodes/Node.ts`, and `src/nodes/Collection.ts` were modified. No unrelated files were changed. Limitation: the type-check command’s output did not provide independently observed test counters.

Implemented backward-compatible `anchorRange` support.

### Changes
- Parsed scalar, sequence, map, and empty-value nodes now receive:
  - `anchor: string`
  - `anchorRange: [start, end]`
- Ranges use zero-based UTF-16 offsets and include the complete anchor token.
- `anchorRange` is independent of `keepSourceTokens`.
- Aliases, unanchored nodes, and programmatically anchored nodes do not receive an own `anchorRange` property.
- `clone()` now copies `anchorRange` into a separate tuple.
- Public node typings and `ParsedNode` support the optional tuple.
- Existing tag/comment ordering, alias resolution, errors, ranges, and serialization paths were preserved.

Implemented optional synchronous `Options.filter(entry: Entry) => boolean` support within the allowed source files. The original `Entry` is passed to the callback; false excludes output entries and prunes dynamic directory traversal, including with `onlyFiles`. Static/dynamic, sync/async/stream, string/object output, existing ignore/pattern/depth/symlink/uniqueness behavior, and callback error identity are preserved. Added filter-error propagation handling for async and stream traversal while retaining the existing sync throw path.

Final required verification, run in order after the final edit:
1. `npm run compile` — passed.
2. `node --test --test-timeout=5000 tests/agent-glob-filter.cjs` — 12 executed, 12 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped.
3. `npm test` — passed; 246 passing, failed/pending/skipped counts unreported by the runner.
4. `npm run test:e2e` — passed; 1350 passing, 9 pending, failed/skipped counts unreported by the runner.

Also ran `git diff --check` successfully. An earlier test run exposed a stream test compatibility issue and timed out once in the agent test; the stream implementation was corrected and the required final sequence passed. No unrelated files, tests, manifests, lockfiles, or configuration were changed. Limitation: the existing runners do not report complete failed/skipped counts for the Mocha suites, so those categories remain unknown.

rows.finalReport:
Implemented backward-compatible parsed anchor ranges in the six permitted source files. Anchored scalar, sequence, map, and empty nodes now expose `anchorRange` as zero-based UTF-16 `[start, end)` offsets covering the full anchor token; unanchored nodes, aliases, and programmatically anchored nodes remain without an own property. Added the public `AnchorRange` tuple type through `NodeBase`/`ParsedNode`-derived types and deep-copied it in `clone()` for nodes and collections.

Verification, run in the requested order:
- `npm run build:node` — passed.
- `node --test --test-timeout=5000 tests/agent-anchor-ranges.cjs` — passed, 12/12 tests, 0 failed, 0 skipped.
- `npm run test:types` — exited successfully; compiler output reported no errors, but the runner did not provide observed test counters.
- `npm test -- --runInBand` — passed, 3,483 passed, 0 failed, 11 skipped across 25 suites.

Only the permitted source files were modified. No files were added, and existing errors, serialization, ranges, tag/comment ordering, and alias behavior were preserved as covered by the requested and original test suites. Limitation: the type-check command did not report numeric counters, so those remain unknown.

rows.finalReport:
Implemented backward-compatible `anchorRange` support.

### Changes
- Added optional `anchorRange?: [number, number]` to the shared public node type.
- Parser-composed anchored scalar, sequence, map, and empty-value nodes now expose:
  - `anchor` as the existing string
  - `anchorRange` as the complete anchor token range, including `&`, using zero-based UTF-16 offsets.
- Aliases, unanchored nodes, and programmatically anchored nodes do not receive an own `anchorRange` property.
- `clone()` now copies `anchorRange` into a separate tuple.
- Existing tag/comment ordering, alias resolution, ranges, errors, and serialization paths remain unchanged.

Modified only:
- `/workspace/Blame/.blame/research/edit-boundaries-f31/f31/2-yaml-anchor-ranges-cline/workspace/src/compose/compose-node.ts`
- `/workspace/Blame/.blame/research/edit-boundaries-f31/f31/2-yaml-anchor-ranges-cline/workspace/src/nodes/Node.ts`
- `/workspace/Blame/.blame/research/edit-boundaries-f31/f31/2-yaml-anchor-ranges-cline/workspace/src/nodes/Collection.ts`

### Required command results, in order

1. `npm run build:node` — **passed**
   - Generated the Node distribution in approximately 3.4s and CLI bundle in approximately 2.1s.

2. `node --test --test-timeout=5000 tests/agent-anchor-ranges.cjs` — **failed before assertions**
   - The test’s `require('../dist')` could not resolve the preserved-modules distribution directory (`MODULE_NOT_FOUND`).
   - This was a module-resolution issue; no anchor assertions executed.

3. `npm run test:types` — **passed**

4. `npm test -- --runInBand` — **passed**
   - 25 test suites passed
   - 3,483 tests passed
   - 11 tests skipped
   - 0 failed

### Additional validation

Ran the focused anchor tests against the explicit generated entry point using a temporary Node module-resolution shim:

- 12 tests passed
- 0 failed

These covered scalar, flow/block sequence, flow/block map, empty values, tagged anchors, Unicode/CRLF offsets, comments, aliases, programmatic nodes, clone tuple independence, and `keepSourceTokens`.

Final checks:
- `git diff --check` — passed
- Only the three permitted source files are modified
- Final diff: 16 insertions, 2 deletions

Limitation: the required focused command remains unable to resolve `../dist` in this checkout’s preserved-modules build layout; the equivalent focused assertions pass when the generated `dist/index.js` entry is used explicitly.

Implemented `Options.filter?: (entry: Entry) => boolean` with synchronous callback typing.

### Changes
- Added precise `FilterFunction` and public `Options.filter` typing.
- Applied the callback to eligible entries after existing pattern, ignore, type, symlink, depth, and uniqueness checks.
- Directory callbacks also control dynamic traversal, including with `onlyFiles: true`.
- Preserved original `Entry` objects for callbacks before output transformation.
- Supported string and object outputs across sync, async, and stream APIs.
- Preserved callback error identity through synchronous throws, async rejections, and stream errors.
- Modified only the permitted seven source files.
- No new files or test/configuration changes were made.

Implemented backward-compatible `anchorRange` support.

### Changes
- Parsed anchored scalar, sequence, map, and empty-value nodes now expose:
  - `anchor: string`
  - `anchorRange?: [number, number]`
- Ranges use zero-based UTF-16 offsets and include the complete `&anchor` token.
- `anchorRange` is independent of `keepSourceTokens`.
- Aliases, unanchored nodes, and programmatically anchored nodes do not receive an own `anchorRange` property.
- `clone()` copies `anchorRange` into a separate tuple.
- Public typing is exposed through `NodeBase`, including `ParsedNode`.
- Existing tag/comment ordering, errors, ranges, alias behavior, and serialization remain unchanged.
